result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visual/content problems: a suspicious '−100%' discount badge that likely indicates a data error, a truncated restaurant name without ellipsis, and a partially visible empty category chip at the right edge.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' shows a '−100%' discount badge, which implies the order is completely free. This is almost certainly a data or calculation error (e.g., discount value misformatted).
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount data source; cap or validate discount percentages so implausible values like −100% are flagged or displayed correctly (e.g., '€0 delivery' if it refers to free delivery).

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card's name is cut off as 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, making the truncation look accidental rather than intentional.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis (…) to card titles, or ensure the peeking card is clearly styled as partially off-screen carousel content.

issues.description: At the right edge of the category chip row, a chip is clipped and appears empty (no visible label), which looks broken.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal padding/peek amount so the next chip shows at least part of its label, or add a fade/gradient edge to signal scrollable content.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) is cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible title or details, so the '−100%' badge floats without context.
issues.suggestion: This may just be scroll position, but consider adding bottom padding so cards aren't awkwardly clipped behind the nav bar, and ensure content isn't obscured by the fixed bottom bar.
